entity: Tesla's Fremont factory: Bay Area air district violation notices and enforcement
what_we_add: Second of 86 plants; notices written on 133 days; peers' median 28 formal actions per 100 notices; Phillips 66 Rodeo (213 notices) also none
why: The notice-count claim matches (Richmondside 374 cited 2015-2025; SFGATE 369 in five years, all pending). The 'no district enforcement order' claim fails: the air district's own release (2024-06-25) and KTVU report an abatement order on the Fremont paint shop, and KQED reports a $1M district settlement over 33 notices in 2021.
